title: Archbishop Hoban vs. NFL Academy — Football (2026–2027)
summary: An international matchup features late Hoban touchdown drives but a 14-point road win for NFL Academy.
article_headline: NFL Academy Europe Defeats Hoban 28–14 at Dowed Field
article_dek: An international matchup features late Hoban touchdown drives but a 14-point road win for NFL Academy.
article_body:
AKRON, Ohio — NFL Academy Europe defeated Archbishop Hoban 28–14 on August 28, 2026, bringing an international football matchup to Dowed Field.

The visiting team built a 21–7 advantage through three quarters. Hoban quarterback Israel “Major” Cribbs helped the Knights respond with an 18-yard touchdown run during the third period. The scoring drive included a 21-yard connection to John Johnson.

NFL Academy quarterback Viktor Lachambre later threw a 20-yard touchdown pass to Nathan Morris, pushing the visitors' lead to 28–7. Hoban running back Kahlil Diming answered with a one-yard score with 2:23 left after breaking runs of 23 and 17 yards on the possession.

The final was 28–14 according to Archbishop Hoban’s official athletics schedule and live reporting from the Akron Beacon Journal. Some third-party score databases display a different home total; the school and local game recap agree on 14. Mason Bybee’s original football photography documents the event.
article_source_label: Akron Beacon Journal · August 28, 2026 live game recap (also Hoban Athletics)
article_highlights: NFL Academy carried a 21–7 lead into the fourth quarter against the Knights.
Hoban quarterback Israel “Major” Cribbs scored on an 18-yard touchdown run in the third quarter.
NFL Academy quarterback Viktor Lachambre found Nathan Morris for a 20-yard fourth-quarter touchdown to make it 28–7.
Hoban running back Kahlil Diming scored from one yard out with 2:23 remaining, after gains of 23 and 17 yards on the drive.
